place_fields.summary: Surviving gateway of Bengaluru Fort on Krishna Rajendra Road in New Tharagupet, near Bengaluru City Market.

planning_attributes.description: The surviving Bengaluru Fort gateway is on Krishna Rajendra Road in New Tharagupet, near Bengaluru City Market (KR Market).
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The remaining gateway is associated with the late-18th-century Mysore-era fort; the fort was built under Hyder Ali and expanded by Tipu Sultan.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Use Krishna Rajendra Road near Bengaluru City Market; Krishna Rajendra Market metro station on the Green Line is the nearest metro stop.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The surrounding market district can be crowded, especially on weekend afternoons.
planning_attributes.notes: The surviving gate is a standalone remnant rather than a complete fort complex.
